workarounds.note: any headings object drops the H1 break, so levels[0].breakBefore is restated to keep parity 'odd' (span: 'page' alone opens each chapter on the next page, whatever its side)
{numberDecimal} and the other numeric variants are empty on headings, so the numeral, the kicker and the thumb tab print {chapterNumber}
config.locale does not localise Figure: resourceTypes: defaultResourceTypes(LANG) is passed by hand
copy fitted so no chapter spills a few lines onto a page before the odd-parity opener, where 1.4.1 paints a column shorter than its block and drops its last line
col() writes the hex beside the paletteId, because design elements and bodyText.referenceColor read the hex (gotcha palette-skips-designs)

{chapterNumber} is measured empty in an H1 opener without a numberingTemplate but painted as the chapter ordinal; harmless here, because an empty design text still takes one line box and minHeight sets the reservation
the numeral and the other design texts take lineHeight as a multiple of their size, never pt(): a Dimension would silently drop the opener's reservation (gotcha design-lineheight-multiple)
hyphenation matches exact codes only, so the config sets locale: t({ en: 'en-us', es: 'es' }) (gotcha hyphenation-locales)
